tara: Observed mismatch between SDK 2.9.1 and runtime 3.5.0 for model orion on long-context streaming. Plan: abort the 10% canary and soft-unpin 3.5.0 in low-traffic regions tonight at 21:30 UTC.

ben: what's the user impact? any customer-visible errors?

tara: only internal integration failures and a single alert from a partner sandbox. Root cause looks like async token flush ordering when function-calls are enabled.

qa_sr: can you paste a representative failure line?

tara: log excerpt: ```
WARN stream: flush-order-mismatch model=orion runtime=3.5.0 sdk=2.9.1 session=abc123
trace: runtime/streamer.go:178 -> runtime/kv.go:412 -> sdk/transport.go:97
```

ops_lee: propose sequence: unpin ap-south -> eu-north -> us-west, 10m validated smoke between each. deploy-bot to run commands and post job ids.

deploy-bot: command received: `unpin runtime 3.5.0 --model orion --regions ap-south --mode soft`
deploy-bot: job queued (job=JB6187659001)

qa_sr: smoke script (short): `curl -X POST https://api.redwood/v1/stream -d '{"model":"orion","stream":true,"input":"long test"}'` run 3x. Will report within 8m.

deploy-bot: ap-south unpin complete (job=JB6187659001)  status=OK

qa_sr: ap-south smoke: 3/3 pass, no flush warnings, p95 OK.

ops_lee: proceeding to eu-north. deploy-bot please queue.

deploy-bot: command received: `unpin runtime 3.5.0 --model orion --regions eu-north --mode soft`
deploy-bot: job queued (job=JB6187659002)

deply-bot: eu-north unpin complete (job=JB6187659002)  status=OK

ben: typo on job confirmation from deploy-bot (deply-bot) but job looks done. eu-north smoke started.

qa_sr: eu-north smoke: 2/3 succeeded, one run had a stream that truncated at token 800. Saving trace to INC-4802.

ops_lee: hold us-west until INC-4802 triage. If INC-4802 reproduces, we will stop and assemble a rollback playbook.

tara: agreed. I'll open a ticket and notify SDK oncall. Also drafting a short customer-facing note: "We've temporarily soft-unpinned runtime 3.5.0 for orion in select regions due to observed streaming flush ordering mismatch when using function-calls. We're validating and will resume staggered unpin only after triage."

support: prepped advisory draft in #support-drafts; will wait for final RCA before posting.

deploy-bot: queued job for us-west (job=JB6187659003) cancelled per hold request.

ops_lee: next steps: SDK and runtime teams to reproduce INC-4802, bench flush ordering with function-calls, and propose a patch. Rollback criteria: any customer error spike or >0.4% stream truncation in smoke runs.

qa_sr: capturing failing request payload and traces in INC-4802 and will attach to the SDK issue.

tara: thanks. Keep this thread open; change window remains tonight but paused until we have SDK repro or a patch.
